description: Use this when the user wants to compare how two or three European Parliament political groups voted across recent final votes on texts (amendments left out), e.g. "how often did EPP and S&D vote the same way". Groups: The Left, S&D, Greens/EFA, Renew, EPP, ECR, PfE, ESN.

groups.description: Two or three group names, e.g. ["EPP", "S&D"].

name: compare_groups
title: Compare political groups
